essence: Sacrifice, austerity, and charity are divided threefold by faith.
Faith-types and scripture's sattva-grounded efficacy are established.
Nature shapes faith, and faith shapes the person.
Worship objects correspond to the three gunas.
Such austerity is tamasic and self-driven rather than scriptural.
